posts.name: Amey Vishwas Daithankar
posts.cooked: I had to change my Motherboard, SSD and reinstall Ubuntu as My computer became dead. I had given SCT in first window which i had passed. Will i be able to give Linux OPPE exam and also can i submit remaining BPT this term from this new system ? As i was forced to change my system do i need to give SCT again for this term exam ? How to login to virtual machine now from new system? Please Guide

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: All you need to do is create a new ssh key using ssh-keygen and upload the public key to the course VM website. Once you are able to access your course VM again, you can solve BPTs on there.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
23f2004340:

do i need to give SCT again for this term exam ?

No, it is not required.
